verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Render's own dashboard or product. The closest item describes an external coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) that uses Render's MCP server and skills to read metrics and recommend a compute plan. That is a developer-facing integration with an external agent, not an in-product insights feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
